title: Draganfly and Estonian-Ukrainian DOD Solution Sign Agreement to Advance AI-Powered Autonomy for Unmanned Systems
body_markdown:
*Collaboration combines DOD Solution’s AURA AI onboard autonomy platform with Canadian engineering to inform integration, testing and advanced development of unmanned systems*


**KYIV, Ukraine, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) —** Draganfly Inc. (NASDAQ: DPRO; CSE: DPRO; FSE: 3U8) (“Draganfly” or the “Company”), a Canadian-headquartered developer of advanced drone solutions, unmanned systems and software, and DOD Solution, an Estonian-Ukrainian developer of onboard autonomy technology, today jointly announced the signing of a memorandum of understanding (“MOU”) to advance integration of DOD Solution’ autonomy technology into selected Draganfly unmanned systems.


The collaboration is designed to combine DOD Solution’ autonomy expertise and insights from Ukraine with Draganfly’s Canadian engineering and systems-integration capabilities. DOD Solution’ AURA AI platform pairs the AURA SBC onboard computer with AURA OS software, designed to support autonomous functions when GPS or communications are degraded or unavailable.


Lessons emerging from Ukraine highlight the importance of testing unmanned systems under realistic operating conditions, adapting as countermeasures evolve and incorporating user feedback into continued development. The collaboration will explore how those lessons can inform autonomy integration and testing against Canadian and allied requirements.


“Canada has an opportunity to apply lessons from Ukraine to the way we develop, test and support unmanned systems,” said Cameron Chell, Chief Executive Officer of Draganfly. “Working with DOD Solution is intended to connect their onboard autonomy technology and operational understanding with our engineering capabilities in Canada. Our focus is on evaluating how autonomy can help systems perform in demanding conditions and building the expertise to integrate and support those capabilities for our customers.”


For Canada, the potential benefit includes deeper technical expertise in autonomy integration, testing and ongoing support, alongside opportunities to strengthen Canadian unmanned systems capabilities. For DOD Solution, the collaboration offers a potential pathway to integrate its technology across additional platforms and explore Canadian and allied customer requirements with Draganfly.


The initiative is consistent with the broader Canada–Ukraine objective of combining Ukrainian innovation with Canadian industrial and technological strengths through research, testing, technology collaboration and licensing.


“Working with Draganfly creates an opportunity to connect our autonomy technology and experience in Ukraine with Canadian engineering and integration expertise,” said Roman Hapachylo, Chief Executive Officer of DOD Solution. “AURA AI brings target detection, recognition, tracking and terminal guidance directly onboard, allowing drones to operate even when GPS is unavailable, jamming is active and communications are limited. We want this level of autonomy to become a core capability of next-generation unmanned systems, and this partnership is another step in that direction.”


**About DOD Solution**


DOD Solution is an Estonian-Ukrainian defence technology company developing onboard computers and autonomy systems for unmanned platforms. The company works with unmanned platform manufacturers to integrate AI-powered autonomy across a wide range of defence applications.


Its flagship product, the AURA AI platform, combines proprietary software and the AURA SBC onboard computer to enable autonomous navigation, perception, target recognition, tracking and terminal guidance in GPS-denied, contested and communication-constrained environments.

**About Draganfly**


Draganfly Inc. (NASDAQ: DPRO; CSE: DPRO; FSE: 3U8) is a Canadian-headquartered developer of advanced drone solutions, unmanned systems and software serving customers across North America and globally. With more than 27 years of experience in unmanned systems, Draganfly develops and delivers technologies spanning aerial platforms, autonomy, sensing, payload integration and mission-specific solutions for defence, public safety and commercial applications.


The Company combines engineering, manufacturing, software and systems-integration capabilities to support customers operating in complex and mission-critical environments. Draganfly is driven by a mission to provide innovative, reliable solutions that save time, money and lives.
